title: The name derivation case checked the task branch but not the working directory, so an adapter with a misnamed or misplaced directory passed
resolution: The fixture names its data root and the case compares each working directory with worker/workspaces/<name>/checkout under it; a double that percent-encodes the directory name failed nothing before and fails the case after

title: The design's example of why safe identifiers keep the digest named a pair that does not collide
resolution: The example is now the safe identifier a_b-<digest of a/b>, whose name would equal that of a/b; no other record or comment held the example
